title: Extraction and Lowry-Assay for Determination of Synechocystis Total Protein
author: Anika Wiegard
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.taseiee
materials: Prepare a Lowry solution by mixing the following reagents in the given order: 500 µl K-Na-tartrate (2%) 500 µl Cu 2 SO 4 *5 H 2 O (1%) 100 ml Na 2 CO 3 (2%) Scale the total volumes down to an appropriate amount. You will need 900 µl Lowry-Mix for each sample. Mix the Lowry-solution on the same day you use it and store it in the fridge in the meantime.

steps.title: Aliquot culture sample
steps.instruction: Pipette 1 ml of Synechocystis culture into a 2 ml Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add TCA and incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Add 110 µl of 100 % trichloracetic acid, mix, and incubate the tube on ice for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet proteins
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 10 minutes at 15 000 g and 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and dry pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant completely, place the tubes upright for 10 minutes, and tap gently until all liquid is removed.

substeps.instruction: Tap tubes carefully to remove residual liquid.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in NaOH and incubate
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 500 µl of 1 M NaOH, vortex, and incubate at room temperature for approximately 16 hours (overnight).

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl of 1 M NaOH to the pellet.
Incubate at room temperature for ~16 h.

steps.title: Mix sample with Lowry reagent
steps.instruction: In a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube, combine 100 µl of the NaOH‑solubilised sample with 900 µl of Lowry‑Mix.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µl of the NaOH‑treated sample to a fresh tube.
Add 900 µl Lowry‑Mix and mix gently.

steps.title: Add Folin reagent and incubate in dark
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of 50 % Folin‑Ciocalteu phenol reagent (diluted in water) and immediately incubate in the dark for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge to clear solution
steps.instruction: Spin the incubated mixture at 14 000 g for 5 minutes to remove lipids and debris.

steps.title: Measure absorbance at 750 nm
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 ml of the cleared solution to a plastic cuvette and record the absorbance at 750 nm.

steps.title: Prepare BSA standards and process
steps.instruction: Prepare BSA standard solutions ranging from 5 to 100 µg ml⁻¹ and subject each standard to steps 1‑9 exactly as described.

substeps.instruction: Process each standard through the entire protocol.
